folderPath.description: Absolute path to the folder whose commit history to read. Only commits that touch this folder (and its subfolders) are listed, even when the Git repository is larger.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return, newest first. Default 30, at most 200.

since.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z): only commits made after it.

ref.description: Optional branch or tag name to read history from. Defaults to HEAD (the checked-out branch).

path.description: Optional file or subfolder path, relative to folderPath, to narrow the history to.
